Our Tree Services in Ann Arbor

Tree Removal — Highland Tree Services provides safe and efficient tree removal solutions tailored to your property's needs. Land Clearing — Prepare your property for new developments or restore open spaces with our professional land clearing services. We tackle projects of all sizes, removing trees, shrubs, and debris efficiently and safely for a clean slate.

Tree / Bush Planting — Bring life to your property with our tree and bush planting services. Our experts help you select the right species and ensure proper planting techniques, giving your new greenery the best chance to thrive in its environment.

Storm Damage Cleanup — Restore your property after severe weather with our storm damage cleanup services. From clearing debris to addressing damaged trees and shrubs, we help you regain order and safety quickly and professionally.

Fallen Tree Cleanup — Highland Tree Services offers fast and reliable fallen tree cleanup to keep your property safe and accessible. We remove trees of all sizes, handling the debris efficiently to leave your space neat and hazard-free.

Key Reasons to Remove Trees:

- Diseased or Dying Trees — A diseased tree can quickly become unstable.
- Structural Risks — Tree roots can disrupt foundations, driveways, and underground utilities.
- Overgrown Trees — Trees growing too close to your home, power lines, or fences can cause damage.
- Landscaping Upgrades — Expanding your yard, installing a pool, or building a new structure often requires clearing trees.
